items.exampleEn: The chef looked at the frozen pizza with disdain.
items.exampleZh: 主廚不屑地看著那片冷凍披薩。

items.exampleEn: He flattered his boss to get a better project.
items.exampleZh: 他奉承老闆，想拿到比較好的專案。

items.exampleEn: They had an unconventional wedding on a mountaintop.
items.exampleZh: 他們在山頂上辦了一場不落俗套的婚禮。

items.exampleEn: Remorse kept him awake all night after the argument.
items.exampleZh: 吵架之後，懊悔讓他整夜睡不著。

items.exampleEn: The train journey was long and tedious.
items.exampleZh: 那趟火車旅程又長又乏味。

items.exampleEn: He felt insecure about his English at his first meeting abroad.
items.exampleZh: 第一次在國外開會時，他對自己的英文沒有信心。
items.glossZh: 沒有安全感的；不穩固的

items.exampleEn: I must commend you for your honesty in this matter.
items.exampleZh: 在這件事上，我必須稱讚你的誠實。

items.exampleEn: The school uniform leaves little room for individuality.
items.exampleZh: 學校制服讓人很難展現個人特色。

items.sentenceEn: Filling out these forms is tedious but necessary.
items.sentenceZh: 填這些表格很乏味，但非填不可。

items.audioEn: The principal commended the students for cleaning the beach on Saturday.
items.audioZh: 校長表揚了星期六去淨灘的學生。
items.questionZh: 學生們為什麼受到表揚？

items.sentenceEn: He felt deep remorse for shouting at his friend.
items.sentenceZh: 他對自己吼了朋友感到深深的懊悔。

items.sentenceEn: Many people feel insecure when they start a new job.
items.sentenceZh: 很多人剛開始一份新工作時都會覺得沒有安全感。

items.stemEn: Her ____ teaching methods, like lessons in the park, surprised the parents.
items.stemZh: 她不落俗套的教學方式，例如在公園上課，讓家長們很驚訝。

items.stemEn: I was ____ when the famous writer asked for my opinion.
items.stemZh: 那位知名作家問我的意見時，我受寵若驚。

items.passageEn: When Kai started art school, he felt insecure about his strange, colorful style. Some classmates looked at his work with disdain and told him to paint "normal" pictures. For a while, he tried, but copying others felt tedious. His teacher noticed and encouraged him to keep his individuality. "Unconventional ideas are what make art interesting," she said. Last spring, a local gallery owner commended Kai's work and showed it in a special exhibition, and critics praised its bold aesthetic qualities. One classmate who had laughed at him later said she felt remorse and apologized.
items.passageZh: Kai 剛進藝術學校時，對自己奇特又色彩繽紛的畫風很沒信心。有些同學不屑地看著他的作品，叫他畫「正常」一點的畫。有一陣子他試著照做，但模仿別人讓他覺得乏味。老師注意到了，鼓勵他保有自己的個人特色。她說：「不落俗套的想法，才讓藝術有趣。」去年春天，當地一家畫廊的老闆肯定了 Kai 的作品，在特展中展出，評論家也讚揚作品大膽的美感。一位曾經嘲笑他的同學後來說她很懊悔，並向他道歉。

questions.questionZh: Kai 剛進藝術學校時有什麼感覺？
options: 覺得同學們都很照顧他
很期待每天和同學一起畫畫

questions.questionZh: 去年春天發生了什麼事？
options: 他轉學到另一所藝術學校
他決定放棄畫畫去讀書

items.promptZh: 你說我唱得很好，我真是受寵若驚。
referenceEn: I am flattered that you think I sing well.
I feel very flattered by what you said about my singing.
rubricZh: be／feel flattered 表示「受寵若驚、感到榮幸」（例如 I am flattered that…、feel flattered by… 等）
「唱得很好」可寫，例如 sing well、my singing 等

items.promptZh: 這位設計師的作品充滿個人特色。
referenceEn: This designer's work is full of individuality.
The designer's works show a lot of individuality.
rubricZh: 「個人特色」用 individuality（例如 full of individuality、show individuality 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：insecure 例句 That old ladder looks insecure 用的是罕見的「不牢固」義，自然英文多說 unsteady／unsafe；本課 shadowing 與閱讀都用「沒安全感」義，卡片宜示範此常用義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改示範單元常用義「沒有安全感」："He felt insecure about his English at his first meeting abroad."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：characterization 再次當干擾項（跨課重複），且為名詞、與形容詞空格詞性不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: characterization 換成本課 individuality，remorse 換成 dismal；tedious、dismal 為形容詞、放得進空格但語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：aesthetic 當名詞（美學風格）沒有級距
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "its bold aesthetic qualities"（形容詞用法）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（mcq 長度名次全級分布：正解最短比例不足）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: bored 換成 uninterested（與「老師記得我名字」不合），正解成為最短選項

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 disappointed、uninterested 放進句中仍說得通（I was uninterested when my old teacher remembered my name）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: disappointed 換成 robust（u04-l02）、uninterested 換成 phenomenal（u04）；放進句中語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長新規則（只看英文）修正：只看英文時 dismal、tedious 放進句中仍說得通（Her dismal/tedious teaching methods… surprised the parents）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: dismal 換成 latent（u04）、tedious 換成 creamy（u04）；放進句中語意不通

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：be／feel flattered 表示「受寵若驚、感到榮幸」（例如 I am flattered that…、feel flattered by… 等）／「唱得很好」可寫，例如 sing well、my singing 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：individuality 表示「個性、個人特色」（例如 show my individuality、express my individuality 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（individuality）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u10-l06-q17；目標字沿用 individuality
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「這位設計師的作品充滿個人特色。」、hintWords ["individuality"]、referenceEn ["This designer's work is full of individuality.","The designer's works show a lot of individuality."]、rubricZh ["「個人特色」用 individuality（例如 full of individuality、show individuality 等）","「作品」可寫，例如 work、works、designs 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 individuality 造一個句子，說說你如何表現自己的個人特色。」、referenceEn ["I show my individuality through the colorful socks I wear.","I express my individuality by decorating my room in my own style."]）
